items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Ben Riley in the context of Thelonious Monk, but the interviewee (Mose Allison) does not respond with any personal connection or interaction with Ben Riley.

ctx.x: Ben Riley played with Monk for years, but that began in 1964...
Ben Riley might have been who it was.
